import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotient
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientFiniteAtlasSections

/-!
# The canonical finite quotient as a geometric quotient

The finite stable affine atlas supplies the orbit fibres, quotient topology,
and invariant structure-sheaf condition required by the generic geometric
quotient interface.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {k G : Type u} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Finite G]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} (act : G →* Aut X) [X.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace X]
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  (hact : ∀ g : G, (act g).hom ≫ p = p)
  (h : OrbitsInAffineOpen act)

/-- The canonical finite quotient projection satisfies the intrinsic geometric
quotient criterion. -/
theorem finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient :
    IsGeometricQuotient act
      (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection act p hact h) := by
  exact IsGeometricQuotient.of_affineOpen act _
    (fun g => act_hom_comp_finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection act p hact h g)
    (finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_isQuotientMap act p hact h)
    (fun x y => finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_eq_iff_exists_act
      act p hact h x y)
    (fun U _ => finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_app_injective act p hact h U)
    (fun U _ s => finiteStableCanonicalQuotientProjection_mem_range_app_iff_actApp
      act p hact h U s)

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
